label: Traced nothing-from-nothing from three grounding principles
description: New non-transcription conditional support option for premise A2 (inert emptiness) of Arrival A in the modal spine to God's existence. Fix a history v and an earlier moment s. For a concrete thing x present at t later than s: if x is present at s the chain is empty. Otherwise x began to be present, so it has a concrete ground g; g has not wholly ceased before s, so it is present at s (one link) or at some u later than s, and since g and x are concrete things present at some moment, the induction hypothesis on g along well-founded grounding gives a concrete thing present at s with a chain to g, extended by the link to x. No frame condition, contingency, presence-to-existence or necessity is used or concluded. All three premises are OPEN framework inputs about every history of the model; omitting any one permits a populated moment after an empty one (controls 1 to 3). The three premises and the conclusion hold in a model with no necessary individual (control 4), so this bundle does not contain the possibility of a necessary concrete being. Nothing is attributed to a source. No premise truth is established.
